projects.title: MGS3 · Build the story
projects.subtitle: Build the outline, cast, world, and relationships. Full MGS3 spoilers.

references.title: Start here · story & scope
references.note:
Metal Gear Solid 3: Snake Eater (2004). Full spoilers, including the ending and post-credits call.

This is a selective story outline, not a room-by-room walkthrough. MICE structure, motives, and block wording are teaching interpretations. Later games’ revelations are outside this project.

references.title: How to read these cards
references.note: Openings describe the starting situation. Closings describe the result. Notes explain context, player-dependent alternatives, or the MICE classification. Character blocks contain traits and facts; timed changes record when those facts change.

references.title: Canon checks & sources
references.note:
Checked against Konami’s story recap, the cited character/mission pages, and a contemporary MGS3 walkthrough.

Sokolov: treated as apparently killed, as presented here in MGS3.
The Sorrow: the procession depends partly on player choices.
The End: this outline follows the standard duel; the game allows alternatives.
Ocelot: the final call is an audience-only reveal.

No game dialogue is reproduced. Scene prose is an original writing exercise.
